products.label: Device #1
products.title: Video stream processing module on SoC
products.summary: For real-time video processing and transmission

image.alt: Video-processing module with an NVIDIA SOM and Ethernet connectors

products.task: Increase system performance by expanding its capabilities.

products.label: Device #2
products.title: High-performance SOM module based on Rockchip RK3568 (DDR4)
products.summary: For embedded computing systems and industrial embedded solutions

image.alt: Compact system-on-module with a Rockchip RK3568 processor and DDR4 memory

products.task: Develop a compact SOM module on the Rockchip RK3568 with DDR4 memory for industrial embedded systems.
problem: High BGA ball density at a 0.5 mm pitch
DDR4 signal integrity in a compact multilayer layout
done: Designed a compact SOM module with the RK3568 and DDR4
Routed high-speed DDR4 lines with impedance control
results: Stable DDR4 operation at full speed
Ready for integration into customer carrier boards
